sentences.l2: “双减”政策出台后，学科类补习班大面积收缩，不少机构一夜之间关门歇业。
sentences.l1: After the "Double Reduction" policy was introduced, academic tutoring classes shrank on a large scale, and quite a few institutions closed down overnight.

sentences.l2: 然而，需求并未随之消失，只是转入地下：一对一家教的价格翻了数倍，家长托熟人在居民楼里租下房间，冒着被查的风险继续给孩子补数学。
sentences.l1: However, the demand did not disappear with them, but only went underground: the price of one-on-one tutors has multiplied several times, and parents ask acquaintances to rent rooms in residential buildings and, at the risk of being caught, keep tutoring their children in math.

sentences.l2: 这种“地下化”带来的后果耐人寻味——课外辅导从明码标价的市场行为，变成了比拼人脉与信息的不平等竞争，无力支付高价家教的普通家庭反而更加被动。
sentences.l1: The consequences of this "going underground" are thought-provoking: extracurricular tutoring has changed from a market activity with clearly marked prices into an unequal competition over connections and information, and ordinary families who cannot afford expensive tutors are even more at a disadvantage.

sentences.l2: 值得注意的是，家长的焦虑并非源于政策本身，而是源于对选拔机制的信任缺失。
sentences.l1: It is worth noting that parents' anxiety does not stem from the policy itself, but from a lack of trust in the selection system.

sentences.l2: 只要升学的独木桥依旧狭窄，教育焦虑就会寻找新的出口：有人转向体育与艺术培训，有人干脆亲自辅导。
sentences.l1: As long as the single-plank bridge to higher education remains narrow, educational anxiety will look for new outlets: some turn to sports and arts training, and some simply tutor their children themselves.

sentences.l2: 因此，减轻负担若要真正落地，恐怕不能只盯着补习班这一端，还需从考试评价与优质资源的分配上寻找答案。
sentences.l1: Therefore, if burden reduction is to truly take effect, it probably cannot focus only on the tutoring-class end, and answers must also be sought in exam evaluation and the distribution of quality resources.
